paragraphs.en: 2026-05-30 🧭 Hermes skill proposed (#320), adding a CLI-Anything orchestration skill with installer scripts and HARNESS fallback guidance. 🗺️ ArcGIS Pro was proposed for the public registry (#318) as a Windows/ArcPy CLI for cartography, geoprocessing, feature editing, and live-Pro MCP workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-30 🧭 提出了 Hermes 技能（#320），新增了一个 CLI-Anything 编排技能，包含安装脚本和 HARNESS 回退指南。🗺️ ArcGIS Pro 被提议加入公共注册表（#318），作为一个用于制图、地理处理、要素编辑以及实时 Pro MCP 工作流的 Windows/ArcPy CLI。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-27 🔧 CLI-Hub registry date updates now handle python -m pip install commands (#312), improving package-date detection for registry automation.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-27 🔧 CLI-Hub 注册表现在能够处理 python -m pip install 命令的日期更新（#312），改进了注册表自动化的软件包日期检测。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-23 📝 Obsidian Agent CLI was proposed for the public registry (#307), bringing a PyPI-installed Obsidian automation CLI with persistent agent memory workflows and a pinned skill link.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-23 📝 Obsidian Agent CLI 被提议纳入公共注册表（#307），它带来一个可通过 PyPI 安装的 Obsidian 自动化 CLI，支持持久化智能体记忆工作流，并包含一个固定版本的技能链接。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-21 🔒 Sketch CLI token-file handling was hardened against path traversal and symlink escapes (#304).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-21 🔒 Sketch CLI 的令牌文件处理已针对路径遍历和符号链接逃逸进行了加固（#304）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-20 📓 Joplin CLI was proposed (#300) with notebooks, notes, to-dos, tags, attachments, search/sync, import/export, server/E2EE helpers, full docs, packaged skill docs, and a 134-test validation baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-20 📓 Joplin CLI 被提议（#300），包含笔记本、笔记、待办事项、标签、附件、搜索/同步、导入/导出、服务器/端到端加密（E2EE）辅助工具、完整文档、打包的技能文档，以及一个包含 134 项测试的验证基线。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-20 🎛️ Rekordbox CLI merged (#252) with guarded SQLCipher write paths, backup-required forced writes, smoke coverage, and root skill sync. 📚 Calibre CLI merged (#223) with library/search/metadata/conversion/export workflows, 41 unit tests, real-Calibre E2E evidence, and root skill validation. 🧊 3MF CLI merged (#209) with mesh inspection, hole resizing, repair, comparison, and preserved triangle attributes. 🎙️ MiniMax CLI merged (#189) with chat/TTS workflows, JSON-safe model/voice listing, REPL quote handling, and smoke/E2E coverage. 🎮 UEAtelier joined the registry (#297) as an Unreal Editor MCP self-extension workbench with a Python CLI proxy.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-20 🎛️ Rekordbox CLI 已合并（#252），包含受保护的 SQLCipher 写入路径、需备份的强制写入、冒烟测试覆盖，以及根技能同步。📚 Calibre CLI 已合并（#223），包含库/搜索/元数据/转换/导出工作流、41 个单元测试、真实 Calibre 端到端（E2E）验证证据，以及根技能验证。🧊 3MF CLI 已合并（#209），包含网格检查、孔洞缩放、修复与对比，并保留三角形属性。🎙️ MiniMax CLI 已合并（#189），包含聊天/文本转语音（TTS）工作流、JSON 安全的模型/音色列表、REPL 引号处理，以及冒烟/端到端（E2E）测试覆盖。🎮 UEAtelier 已加入注册表（#297），作为一个配备 Python CLI 代理的 Unreal Editor MCP 自扩展工作台。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-19 🛠️ Existing harnesses got a quality/security pass — Zoom downloads recordings from direct URLs (#294), Obsidian search now uses the Local REST API vendor content types (#289), LibreOffice headless conversion is more robust on macOS (#290), and XML/SVG/ODF/MLT/MusicXML/CSL parsing now routes untrusted input through defusedxml (#296).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-19 🛠️ 现有的测试框架（harness）进行了一轮质量/安全改进 —— Zoom 现在支持从直接 URL 下载录音（#294），Obsidian 搜索现已使用 Local REST API 的厂商内容类型（#289），LibreOffice 无头转换在 macOS 上更加稳健（#290），并且 XML/SVG/ODF/MLT/MusicXML/CSL 解析现在将不可信输入通过 defusedxml 进行处理（#296）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-18 📈 README presentation refreshed with the Trendshift badge and centered project header polish (#285, #286), keeping the landing section focused on discovery and project momentum.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-18 📈 README 演示更新：添加了 Trendshift 徽章并优化了居中的项目页眉（#285、#286），使落地页部分继续聚焦于项目发现与项目发展势头。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-17 🌐 CLI-Hub registry handling was hardened (#281) — registry entries are now copied before _source tagging, preventing cached or mocked registry data from being mutated in place.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-17 🌐 强化了对 CLI-Hub 注册表的处理（#281）——注册表条目现在会在添加 _source 标签之前先被复制，防止缓存或模拟的注册表数据被就地修改。

paragraphs.en: 2026-05-16 🔧 n8n received the REPL banner crash fix that later merged into main (#280), restoring the no-subcommand interactive startup path with regression coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-05-16 🔧 n8n 获得了 REPL 横幅崩溃修复，该修复后来合并入 main（#280），恢复了无子命令的交互式启动路径，并附带了回归测试覆盖。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-18 🧩 All SKILL.md files are now being unified under the top-level skills/ directory — every CLI skill can be installed from one canonical source with npx skills add HKUDS/CLI-Anything --skill <skill-name> -g -y . We also added root-skill validation CI, synced contribution / PR docs and REPL skill-path hints to the new layout, and refreshed the CLI-Hub install-first frontend around the new npx skills flow.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-18 🧩 所有 SKILL.md 文件现已统一归入顶层的 skills/ 目录 —— 每个命令行技能（CLI skill）都可以从唯一的权威来源安装，只需运行 npx skills add HKUDS/CLI-Anything --skill <skill-name> -g -y 。 我们还新增了根技能校验 CI，将贡献 / PR 文档与 REPL 技能路径提示同步到新目录结构，并围绕新的 npx skills 流程刷新了以安装为先的 CLI-Hub 前端。

sents.en: 2026-04-18 🧩 All SKILL.md files are now being unified under the top-level skills/ directory — every CLI skill can be installed from one canonical source with npx skills add HKUDS/CLI-Anything --skill <skill-name> -g -y .
sents.zh: 2026-04-18 🧩 所有 SKILL.md 文件现已统一归入顶层的 skills/ 目录 —— 每个命令行技能（CLI skill）都可以从唯一的权威来源安装，只需运行 npx skills add HKUDS/CLI-Anything --skill <skill-name> -g -y 。

sents.en: We also added root-skill validation CI, synced contribution / PR docs and REPL skill-path hints to the new layout, and refreshed the CLI-Hub install-first frontend around the new npx skills flow.
sents.zh: 我们还新增了根技能校验 CI，将贡献 / PR 文档与 REPL 技能路径提示同步到新目录结构，并围绕新的 npx skills 流程刷新了以安装为先的 CLI-Hub 前端。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-17 🌐 CLI-Hub received another install UX pass — public registry metadata and skill coverage were tightened, visit counting was corrected, and the web hub was further refined. 🧪 Shotcut render output duration was fixed (#92). 📝 SKILL contribution paths were corrected for the new docs flow (#224), and the skill generator now safely handles empty intros (#203).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-17 🌐 CLI-Hub 迎来了又一轮安装体验优化——公共注册表元数据和技能覆盖率得到收紧，访问计数得到修正，Web 枢纽也进一步完善。🧪 修复了 Shotcut 渲染输出时长问题（#92）。📝 针对 新的文档流程，修正了 SKILL 贡献路径（#224），且技能生成器现在可以安全处理空简介（#203）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-16 🗺️ QGIS CLI merged (#207) — a full GIS / map authoring harness landed. 🧬 UniMol Tools CLI merged (#219) for molecular modeling workflows. 🌐 CLI-Hub also added more public CLIs, including py4csr , refreshed its generated meta-skill, corrected SKILL contribution docs, and fixed apt-get package extraction in skill generation (#204).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-16 🗺️ QGIS CLI 已合并（#207）——一个完整的 GIS / 地图制作工具集落地。🧬 UniMol Tools CLI 已合并（#219），用于分子建模工作流。🌐 CLI-Hub 还添加了更多公开 CLI，包括 py4csr，刷新了其生成的元技能，修正了 SKILL 贡献文档，并修复了技能生成中 apt-get 包提取的问题（#204）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-16 📈 Unreal Insights CLI expanded — added background capture session control ( capture start/status/snapshot/stop ), engine-root-matched UnrealInsights.exe resolution/build flows, and refreshed docs/tests for the new orchestration workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-16 📈 Unreal Insights CLI 功能扩展 — 新增了后台捕获会话控制（capture start/status/snapshot/stop）、基于引擎根目录匹配的 UnrealInsights.exe 解析/构建流程，并为新的编排工作流程更新了文档/测试。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-15 🌐 CLI-Hub updated to v0.2.0 — the PyPI package now supports public CLIs from multiple install sources ( pip , npm , brew , bundled/system tools), backed by a new public_registry.json . The Hub frontend was redesigned with separate CLI-Anything CLIs and Public CLIs decks, and live end-to-end checks now cover real install, update, and uninstall flows across both pip and npm packages.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-15 🌐 CLI-Hub 更新至 v0.2.0 — PyPI 包现在支持来自多种安装来源的公开 CLI（pip、npm、brew、捆绑/系统工具），并新增 public_registry.json 作为支撑。 Hub 前端经过重新设计，分为 CLI-Anything CLI 和公开 CLI 两个面板，并且现在的实时端到端检查覆盖了 pip 和 npm 包的真实安装、更新和卸载流程。

sents.en: 2026-04-15 🌐 CLI-Hub updated to v0.2.0 — the PyPI package now supports public CLIs from multiple install sources ( pip , npm , brew , bundled/system tools), backed by a new public_registry.json .
sents.zh: 2026-04-15 🌐 CLI-Hub 更新至 v0.2.0 — PyPI 包现在支持来自多种安装来源的公开 CLI（pip、npm、brew、捆绑/系统工具），并新增 public_registry.json 作为支撑。

sents.en: The Hub frontend was redesigned with separate CLI-Anything CLIs and Public CLIs decks, and live end-to-end checks now cover real install, update, and uninstall flows across both pip and npm packages.
sents.zh: Hub 前端经过重新设计，分为 CLI-Anything CLI 和公开 CLI 两个面板，并且现在的实时端到端检查覆盖了 pip 和 npm 包的真实安装、更新和卸载流程。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-14 🧭 Safari CLI merged (#212) and added to the Hub registry — browser automation via safari-mcp . 🎬 Kdenlive also received compatibility fixes for Gen 5 project output and invalid project generation.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-14 🧭 Safari CLI 已合并（#212）并加入 Hub 注册表——通过 safari-mcp 实现浏览器自动化。🎬 Kdenlive 同时获得了针对 Gen 5 项目输出与无效项目生成的兼容性修复。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-13 📓 Obsidian CLI merged (#211) — knowledge management harness via the Local REST API, with 48 unit tests and 7 E2E tests. ⛓️ Eth2-Quickstart CLI merged (#195) — Ethereum staking node management harness. 📚 Zotero CLI updated to v0.4.1 (#201) — now shipped from its standalone repo, and CLI-Hub gained support for remote skill_md URLs.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-13 📓 Obsidian CLI 已合并（#211）——通过 Local REST API 实现的知识管理工具集（harness），包含 48 个单元测试和 7 个端到端（E2E）测试。⛓️ Eth2-Quickstart CLI 已合并（#195）——以太坊（Ethereum）质押节点管理工具集（harness）。📚 Zotero CLI 已更新至 v0.4.1（#201）——现从其独立仓库发布，且 CLI-Hub 新增了对远程 skill_md URL 的支持。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-11 🔗 n8n CLI merged (#188) — workflow automation harness for self-hosted automation flows. 🔧 Exa CLI fix (#205) added the x-exa-integration header for usage tracking. 📦 CLI-Hub also gained its PyPI auto-publish workflow and package refresh pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-11 🔗 n8n CLI 已合并（#188）——面向自托管自动化流程的工作流自动化工具。🔧 Exa CLI 修复（#205）添加了用于使用量跟踪的 x-exa-integration 请求头。📦 CLI-Hub 还新增了其 PyPI 自动发布工作流和软件包刷新流水线。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-10 📦 CLI-Hub package manager launched — pip install cli-anything-hub to browse, search, install, update, and uninstall CLI-Anything harnesses from one command. The web Hub also shipped its first install-focused frontend refresh and "Empower yourself" toolkit card.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-10 📦 CLI-Hub 软件包管理器正式发布——运行 pip install cli-anything-hub 即可通过一条命令浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载 CLI-Anything 工具集。 网页版 Hub 也同步推出了首次以安装为核心的前端界面更新以及「赋能自己」工具包卡片。

sents.en: 2026-04-10 📦 CLI-Hub package manager launched — pip install cli-anything-hub to browse, search, install, update, and uninstall CLI-Anything harnesses from one command.
sents.zh: 2026-04-10 📦 CLI-Hub 软件包管理器正式发布——运行 pip install cli-anything-hub 即可通过一条命令浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载 CLI-Anything 工具集。

sents.en: The web Hub also shipped its first install-focused frontend refresh and "Empower yourself" toolkit card.
sents.zh: 网页版 Hub 也同步推出了首次以安装为核心的前端界面更新以及「赋能自己」工具包卡片。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-09 🧹 Cleanup and docs pass (#200) — fixed Openscreen test subtotals, added Openscreen to the Chinese README and project structure, and clarified /cli-anything command syntax in the docs.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-09 🧹 清理与文档更新（#200）——修复了 Openscreen 测试的小计，将 Openscreen 添加到中文 README 和项目结构中，并在文档中澄清了 /cli-anything 命令的语法。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-08 🎬 Openscreen CLI merged (#183) — screen recording editor harness with 101 tests. ☁️ CloudAnalyzer CLI merged (#181) — cloud cost analysis harness with 27 commands. 🌊 SeaClip / PM2 / ChromaDB harnesses merged (#129).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-08 🎬 Openscreen CLI 已合并（#183）—— 带有 101 个测试的屏幕录制编辑器测试框架。☁️ CloudAnalyzer CLI 已合并（#181）—— 带有 27 个命令的云成本分析测试框架。🌊 SeaClip / PM2 / ChromaDB 测试框架已合并（#129）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-07 🔄 Dify Workflow CLI merged (#191) — workflow automation wrapper. 🔧 Inkscape auto-save fix (#193, fixes #182). 🛡️ DomShell security hardening (#156) — URL validation and DOM sanitization for the browser CLI. 🥧 Pi Coding Agent extension merged (#178).
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-07 🔄 Dify 工作流 CLI 已合并（#191）——工作流自动化封装工具。🔧 Inkscape 自动保存修复（#193，修复 #182）。🛡️ DomShell 安全加固（#156）——为浏览器 CLI 提供 URL 验证与 DOM 清理。🥧 Pi Coding Agent 扩展已合并（#178）。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-06 🔍 Exa CLI merged (#172) — AI-powered web search and answers harness. 🎮 Godot CLI merged (#140) — game engine harness with a full demo-game E2E pipeline. ☁️ CloudAnalyzer review fixes and frontend improvements also landed.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-06 🔍 Exa CLI 已合并（#172）——AI 驱动的网页搜索与回答工具。🎮 Godot CLI 已合并（#140）——带有完整演示游戏端到端（E2E）流水线的游戏引擎工具。☁️ CloudAnalyzer 的评审修复和前端改进也已合入。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-03 🧪 WireMock CLI merged (#170) — HTTP mock server harness for API testing. 🥧 Pi Coding Agent extension support also landed, and CLI demo recordings were added to the docs.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-03 🧪 WireMock CLI 已合并（#170）——用于 API 测试的 HTTP 模拟服务器工具。🥧 Pi Coding Agent 的扩展支持也已落地，并且文档中新增了 CLI 演示录像。

paragraphs.en: 2026-04-01 ⚔️ Slay the Spire II CLI merged (#148) — deck-building roguelike harness. 🎥 VideoCaptioner CLI merged (#166) — AI-powered video captioning harness. 🛰️ IntelWatch was added to the registry for B2B OSINT workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-04-01 ⚔️ Slay the Spire II CLI 已合并（#148）——卡组构建类 roguelike 测试框架。🎥 VideoCaptioner CLI 已合并（#166）——AI 驱动的视频字幕生成测试框架。🛰️ IntelWatch 已被添加至注册表，用于 B2B OSINT 工作流。

paragraphs.en: 2026-03-30 🏗️ CLI-Anything v0.2.0 — HARNESS.md progressive disclosure redesign. Detailed guides extracted into guides/ for on-demand loading. Phases 1–7 now contiguous. Key Principles and Rules merged into a single authoritative section.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-03-30 🏗️ CLI-Anything v0.2.0 — HARNESS.md 渐进式披露重新设计。 详细指南已拆分至 guides/ 目录以便按需加载。 阶段 1–7 现已连续排列。 关键原则与规则合并为单一权威章节。

sents.en: 2026-03-30 🏗️ CLI-Anything v0.2.0 — HARNESS.md progressive disclosure redesign.

paragraphs.en: CLI is the universal interface for both humans and AI agents:
paragraphs.zh: CLI 是人类和 AI 智能体的通用接口：

paragraphs.en: • Structured & Composable - Text commands match LLM format and chain for complex workflows
paragraphs.zh: • 结构化与可组合 - 文本命令符合大语言模型（LLM）格式，并可串联起来构建复杂工作流

paragraphs.en: • Lightweight & Universal - Minimal overhead, works across all systems without dependencies
paragraphs.zh: • 轻量且通用 - 开销极小，无需依赖即可在所有系统上运行

paragraphs.en: • Self-Describing - --help flags provide automatic documentation agents can discover
paragraphs.zh: • 自描述 - --help 标志提供智能体可以自动发现的文档

paragraphs.en: • Proven Success - Claude Code runs thousands of real workflows through CLI daily
paragraphs.zh: • 成效显著 - Claude Code 每天通过 CLI 运行数千个真实工作流

paragraphs.en: • Agent-First Design - Structured JSON output eliminates parsing complexity
paragraphs.zh: • 智能体优先设计 - 结构化 JSON 输出消除了解析复杂性

paragraphs.en: • Deterministic & Reliable - Consistent results enable predictable agent behavior
paragraphs.zh: 确定性且可靠——一致的结果使智能体行为可预测

paragraphs.en: After the initial build, you can iteratively refine the CLI to expand coverage and add missing capabilities:
paragraphs.zh: 初始构建完成后，你可以迭代地改进 CLI，以扩大覆盖范围并添加缺失的功能：

paragraphs.en: # Broad refinement — agent analyzes gaps across all capabilities /cli-anything:refine ./gimp # Focused refinement — target a specific functionality area /cli-anything:refine ./gimp " I want more CLIs on image batch processing and filters " The refine command performs gap analysis between the software's full capabilities and current CLI coverage, then implements new commands, tests, and documentation for the identified gaps. You can run it multiple times to steadily expand coverage — each run is incremental and non-destructive.
paragraphs.zh: # 广度精炼——智能体分析所有功能模块中的缺口 /cli-anything:refine ./gimp # 聚焦精炼——针对特定的功能领域 /cli-anything:refine ./gimp “我希望在图像批处理和滤镜方面有更多的 CLI” refine 命令会对软件的完整功能与当前 CLI 覆盖范围之间进行缺口分析，然后针对识别出的缺口实现新的命令、测试和文档。 你可以多次运行它以稳步扩大覆盖范围——每次运行都是增量的且不会破坏已有内容。

paragraphs.en: An agent drives a live, open ArcGIS Pro session through an MCP bridge — reading the project, zooming the map to feature layers, running geoprocessing, and exporting layouts — while each step executes inside Pro as you watch. paragraphs.zh: # 从本地源码为 GIMP 构建完整的 CLI /cli-anything /home/user/gimp # 从 GitHub 仓库构建 /cli-anything https://github.com/blender/blender # 优化现有的测试套件 — 广泛的差距分析 /cli-anything:refine /home/user/gimp # 针对特定重点领域进行优化 /cli-anything:refine /home/user/shotcut " 视频内嵌视频与画中画合成 " # 运行测试并更新 TEST.md /cli-anything:test /home/user/inkscape # 按照 HARNESS.md 标准进行验证 /cli-anything:validate /home/user/audacity 🎮 演示：使用生成的 CLI 以下是智能体可以使用 cli-anything-libreoffice 做的事情：

paragraphs.en: # Create a new Writer document $ cli-anything-libreoffice document new -o report.json --type writer ✓ Created Writer document: report.json # Add content $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json writer add-heading -t " Q1 Report " --level 1 ✓ Added heading: " Q1 Report " $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json writer add-table --rows 4 --cols 3 ✓ Added 4×3 table # Export to real PDF via LibreOffice headless $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json export render output.pdf -p pdf --overwrite ✓ Exported: output.pdf (42,831 bytes) via libreoffice-headless # JSON mode for agent consumption $ cli-anything-libreoffice --json document info --project report.json { " name " : " Q1 Report " , " type " : " writer " , " pages " : 1, " elements " : 2, " modified " : true } REPL Mode $ cli-anything-blender ╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ cli-anything-blender v1.0.0 ║ ║ Blender CLI for AI Agents ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝ blender> scene new --name ProductShot ✓ Created scene: ProductShot blender[ProductShot]> object add-mesh --type cube --location 0 0 1 ✓ Added mesh: Cube at (0, 0, 1) blender[ProductShot]*> render execute --output render.png --engine CYCLES ✓ Rendered: render.png (1920×1080, 2.3 MB) via blender --background blender[ProductShot]> exit Goodbye! 👋 📖 The Standard Playbook: HARNESS.md HARNESS.md is our definitive SOP for making any software agent-accessible via automated CLI generation.
paragraphs.zh: # 创建一个新的 Writer 文档 $ cli-anything-libreoffice document new -o report.json --type writer ✓ 已创建 Writer 文档：report.json # 添加内容 $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json writer add-heading -t " Q1 Report " --level 1 ✓ 已添加标题：" Q1 Report " $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json writer add-table --rows 4 --cols 3 ✓ 已添加 4×3 表格 # 通过 LibreOffice 无头模式导出为真实 PDF $ cli-anything-libreoffice --project report.json export render output.pdf -p pdf --overwrite ✓ 已导出：output.pdf（42,831 字节），经由 libreoffice-headless # 用于智能体消费的 JSON 模式 $ cli-anything-libreoffice --json document info --project report.json { " name " : " Q1 Report " , " type " : " writer " , " pages " : 1, " elements " : 2, " modified " : true } REPL 模式 $ cli-anything-blender ╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ cli-anything-blender v1.0.0 ║ ║ 面向 AI 智能体的 Blender CLI ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝ blender> scene new --name ProductShot ✓ 已创建场景：ProductShot blender[ProductShot]> object add-mesh --type cube --location 0 0 1 ✓ 已添加网格：Cube，位于 (0, 0, 1) blender[ProductShot]*> render execute --output render.png --engine CYCLES ✓ 已渲染：render.png（1920×1080，2.3 MB），经由 blender --background blender[ProductShot]> exit 再见！ 👋 📖 标准操作手册：HARNESS.md HARNESS.md 是我们权威的标准操作程序（SOP），用于通过自动化 CLI 生成让任何软件都能被智能体访问。
